mapper.select: SELECT monthly_income, monthly_rent_limit FROM user_profiles WHERE user_id = #{userId}

SELECT up.deposit_limit AS target_deposit_won, ip.current_deposit AS current_deposit_won FROM user_profiles up INNER JOIN independence_progress ip ON ip.user_id = up.user_id WHERE up.user_id = #{userId}
SELECT house_compare_completed_at FROM independence_progress WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT house_confirmed_at FROM independence_progress WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE independence_progress SET house_compare_completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND house_compare_completed_at IS NULL

UPDATE independence_progress SET confirmed_house_id = #{confirmedHouseId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, house_confirmed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND house_confirmed_at IS NULL
